```yaml
name: copilot-setup-steps
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js and Install Dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-node-and-install
      - name: Build all packages
        run: pnpm turbo build
```
